# Expression and claim detectors

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/walls)

Expose pure text detectors for expression patterns, claims and implementation limits.

**Scope:** Heuristic functions over input text; they do not establish identity, consciousness, consent, truth or authority.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/walls`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Expression, substrate-honesty and self-improvement detector modules are present. Their source vocabulary reflects the project culture and requires interpretation by the caller.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Review detector precision and consumer behavior before treating matches as decisions; preserve the optional nature of cultural framing.
